entries.title: MAC1 - Workorder | Amount discount shows as a percentage when its card is highlighted
entries.notes: Finding 6.13. Severity Low. QA Trans Disc 50 shows "50%" when highlighted and 50 SAR when not; the cart deducts 50.00 correctly. Draft ready, waiting for review. Portal and MAC1 integration, Portal_MacOne_Integration_Report.md.

entries.title: MAC1 - Workorder | Service package is added to the cart with a wrong quantity (64, 32 or 7) instead of 1

entries.title: MAC1 - Workorder | Oil chosen in the package screen does not reach the portal work order line
entries.notes: Finding 6.15. Severity Medium. SalWorkOrderServicePackageItems is empty. Needs a dev check. Portal and MAC1 integration, Portal_MacOne_Integration_Report.md.

entries.title: MAC1 - Workorder | Discount stays attached to the work order after Cancel and Clear cart
entries.notes: Finding 6.16. Severity Medium. QA Trans Disc 50 was applied again when a new item was added. Portal and MAC1 integration, Portal_MacOne_Integration_Report.md.

entries.title: MAC1 - Workorder | Package lines move to another WO and Sync fails

entries.title: Inventory Value: how should negative stock be handled, and which unit cost method is used?
entries.notes: POS Dashboard. Asked 2026-11-13, resent 2026-11-14 as question 4 (old 17). Linked to POS-D06.

question.answer: Negative stock is corrected normally from the Stock Adjustment screen. Cost is based on the user input. The feature is not fully ready yet (user 23/11).
